Title: NX 15
Product Description:
The NX 15 is a passive full-range loudspeaker built around a low-distortion 15-inch neodymium woofer and a 1.5-inch neodymium HF driver, for touring and installation sound reinforcement.

  • 15-inch neodymium woofer + 1.5-inch neodymium HF driver

  • Passive, pole-mountable

  • Part of the NX touring/install series

Title: NX 10
Product Description:
The NX 10 is a compact passive full-range loudspeaker in the NX series, suited to portable sound reinforcement and installation where a smaller format is needed.

  • Compact 10-inch full-range NX-series speaker

  • Passive, pole-mountable

  • Touring and installation use

Title: STING 8 - 74
Product Description:
The STING 8 - 74 integrates two 8-inch neodymium woofers with a 1.5-inch neodymium HF driver in a coherent point-source design with a 74-degree horn for focused directivity and high sound power.

  • Two 8-inch neodymium woofers + 1.5-inch neodymium HF driver

  • Point-source design with rotatable horn

  • 74-degree coverage variant

Title: AIR-152
Product Description:
The AIR-152 is a passive installation loudspeaker built around a 15-inch coaxial driver, with multiple mounting-hardware options for fixed installs.

  • 15-inch coaxial driver

  • Installation-focused with versatile mounting

  • IP variant available for outdoor use

Title: HORNET 12
Product Description:
The HORNET 12 is a large-format three-way touring line array element combining dual 12-inch woofers, quad 6-inch midranges and dual 1.4-inch HF drivers, all neodymium, for high power handling and SPL with an advanced flying-hardware concept.

  • Three-way line array: 2 x 12-inch + 4 x 6-inch + 2 x 1.4-inch HF

  • All-neodymium, high power handling

  • Advanced flying hardware, ground-cart deployable

Title: Fly-6L
Product Description:
The Fly-6L is a compact powered line array module for small concert halls, theaters and clubs, each box driven by a Powersoft 4-channel digital amplifier module with DSP and integrated flying hardware.

  • 4 x 6-inch neodymium mids + 2 x 1-inch neodymium HF drivers

  • Built-in Powersoft amplifier with DSP

  • Integrated flying hardware; lightweight

Title: Sub 18 IP
Product Description:
The Sub 18 IP is a single-18 vented passive subwoofer with weather resistance for outdoor deployment, delivering serious low end in mobile and fixed installs.

  • Single 18-inch vented passive subwoofer

  • Weather-resistant (IP) enclosure

  • M10 / install-friendly

Title: Sub 15
Product Description:
The Sub 15 is a single-15 vented passive subwoofer for mobile and installed systems requiring compact, high-output low frequencies.

  • Single 15-inch vented passive subwoofer

  • 15-inch woofer with 4-inch voice coil

Title: Sub 15 IP
Product Description:
The Sub 15 IP is the weather-resistant version of the Sub 15 vented subwoofer for outdoor installations.

  • Weather-resistant 15-inch vented subwoofer

  • Outdoor installation use

Title: Sub 28A
Product Description:
The Sub 28A is the powered (active) version of the dual-18 Sub 28, using two highly efficient 18-inch drivers for heavy low end in mobile rigs and fixed installs.

  • Powered dual 18-inch subwoofer

  • Two efficient 18-inch drivers

  • Active version of the Sub 28

Title: S218
Product Description:
The S218 is MAG Audio's flagship dual-18 vented subwoofer, compatible with MAG's Uni-Preset technology so it pairs out-of-the-box with any MAG Audio speaker.

  • Flagship dual 18-inch vented subwoofer

  • Uni-Preset compatibility with the MAG range

Title: Sub H28
Product Description:
The Sub H28 is a passive hybrid-horn subwoofer using two high-power 18-inch neodymium woofers for high power handling and very high sensitivity, designed as the low-frequency companion to the HORNET 12 line array.

  • Dual 18-inch neodymium hybrid-horn subwoofer

  • Very high sensitivity and output

  • Companion to the HORNET 12 line array

Title: AIR-S15
Product Description:
The AIR-S15 is a 15-inch installation subwoofer with a compact enclosure and versatile mounting brackets for indoor and outdoor use (IP variant available).

  • 15-inch installation subwoofer

  • Versatile mounting brackets

  • IP variant for outdoor use

Title: AIR-S26A
Product Description:
The AIR-S26A is the powered version of the ultra-compact AIR-S26 installation subwoofer, using two 6.5-inch high-excursion woofers with a built-in Class-D amplifier in a low-profile IP54 enclosure.

  • Powered subcompact dual 6.5-inch install subwoofer

  • Built-in Class-D amplifier

  • Low 16.5 cm profile; IP54 rated

Title: Cluster S15
Sub Title: 15-inch installation subwoofer for the Cluster series
Product Description:
The Cluster S15 is a vented-box installation subwoofer providing low-frequency support to the Cluster line array series, with integrated flying hardware.

  • 15-inch vented installation subwoofer

  • Integrated flying hardware

  • Low-frequency support for the Cluster series

Title: IO-6000
Product Description:
The IO-6000 is an 8-channel Class-D amplifier and system processor on MAG's DANA PRO DSP platform, with a full matrix router, EQ, delay, AES3 inputs, Web UI and preloaded MAG speaker presets.

  • 8 x 750 W RMS at 4 Ohm

  • DANA PRO DSP: matrix router, EQ, delay

  • Analog + up to 16 AES3 inputs; Web UI

Title: IO-8000
Product Description:
The IO-8000 is an 8-channel Class-D amplifier and system processor on MAG's DANA PRO DSP platform, with matrix routing, EQ, delay, AES3 inputs and a Web UI.

  • 8 x 1000 W RMS at 4 Ohm

  • DANA PRO DSP with matrix router and EQ

  • Analog + AES3 inputs; Web UI

Title: IO-16000
Product Description:
The IO-16000 is an 8-channel high-power Class-D amplifier and system processor on the DANA PRO DSP platform for large-scale systems.

  • 8 x 2000 W RMS at 4 Ohm

  • DANA PRO DSP processing

  • Class-D, 2U

Title: IQ-3000
Product Description:
The IQ-3000 is a 4-channel Class-D amplifier and system processor on MAG's DANA PRO DSP platform.

  • 4 x 750 W at 4 Ohm

  • DANA PRO DSP processing

  • Class-D, 2U

Title: IQ-4000
Product Description:
The IQ-4000 is a 4-channel Class-D amplifier and system processor on MAG's DANA PRO DSP platform.

  • 4 x 1000 W at 4 Ohm

  • DANA PRO DSP processing

  • Class-D, 2U

Title: AIR-122
Product Description:
AIR-122 is a passive installation system based on a 12-inch coaxial woofer. Compact size, light weight, and numerous mounting options make AIR-122 a high-usability system that achieves maximum performance per occupied space.

  • 12-inch coaxial driver with 96 dB sensitivity and 132 dB max SPL

  • 80 x 80 degrees nominal coverage angle

  • VESA 100 x 100, dual M10 fly points, and M10 safety point

Title: AIR-82
Product Description:
The passive installation speaker AIR-82 is extremely compact, featuring an 8-inch coaxial woofer. The model has numerous mounting options, providing usability for each and every project.

  • 8-inch coaxial driver with 94 dB sensitivity and 127 dB max SPL

  • 90 x 90 degrees coverage with 4/8/16 Ohm impedance options

  • VESA 75 x 75, dual M10 fly points, and M10 safety point

Title: AIR-C5
Sub Title: Compact 5.25-inch two-way passive install speaker, IP54
Product Description:
The compact yet powerful AIR-C5 is equipped with a 5.25-inch woofer and an HF driver on a rotatable horn. It is compatible with horizontal and vertical adjustable mountings and is available in both Hi-Z and Lo-Z versions.

  • 5.25-inch LF driver and 1-inch carbon fiber HF on rotatable horn

  • 100 x 70 degrees coverage, 119.5 dB max SPL

  • IP54 weather-rated Polycomp enclosure with VESA 50 x 50 mounting

Title: AIR-C6
Sub Title: Compact 6.5-inch two-way passive install speaker, IP54
Product Description:
Packing a powerful punch, AIR-C6 is based on a 6.5-inch woofer and an HF driver on a rotatable horn. This installation speaker offers versatile mounting and is available in 8 and 16 Ohm versions for flexible amplifier connection.

  • 6.5-inch LF driver with 1.35-inch VC HF on rotatable horn

  • 90 x 60 degrees coverage, 125 dB max SPL, 150 W

  • IP54 Polycomp enclosure with VESA 75 x 75 mounting

Title: AIR-C8
Sub Title: Powerful 8-inch two-way passive install speaker, IP54
Product Description:
The most powerful AIR-C8 has a long-excursion 8-inch woofer and an HF driver on a rotatable horn. It is compatible with horizontal and vertical adjustable mountings and is available in 8 and 16 Ohm versions for optimal wiring and amplifier connection.

  • 8-inch long-excursion LF driver with 1.35-inch VC HF on rotatable horn

  • 90 x 60 degrees coverage, 128 dB max SPL, 200 W

  • IP54 Polycomp enclosure with VESA 75 x 75 mounting

Title: AIR-CX-10
Sub Title: 10-inch coaxial passive install loudspeaker, 90 x 90 coverage
Product Description:
AIR-CX-10 is a 10-inch coaxial loudspeaker engineered for balanced output, clarity, and coverage in medium to large installations. The unit features a conical dispersion pattern suitable for varied mounting orientations and is compatible with pan-tilt brackets and VESA mounting systems.

  • 10-inch coaxial driver with 2.5-inch voice coil, 95 dB sensitivity

  • 90 x 90 degrees nominal coverage, 120 dB max SPL

  • VESA 100 x 100, 8 x M10 fly points, M10 safety point

Title: AIR-CX-12
Sub Title: 12-inch coaxial passive install loudspeaker, 90 x 90 coverage
Product Description:
AIR-CX-12 is a 12-inch coaxial loudspeaker engineered for balanced output, clarity, and coverage in medium to large installations. The speaker features conical dispersion for consistent sound in various mounting orientations and accommodates pan-tilt U-brackets and VESA 100 x 100 rear mounting.

  • 12-inch coaxial driver with 2.5-inch voice coil, 97 dB sensitivity

  • 90 x 90 degrees coverage, 121 dB max SPL, 300 W

  • VESA 100 x 100, 8 x M10 fly points, M10 safety point

Title: AIR-CX-15
Sub Title: 15-inch coaxial passive install loudspeaker, 90 x 90 coverage
Product Description:
AIR-CX-15 is a 15-inch coaxial loudspeaker engineered for balanced output, clarity, and coverage in medium to large installations. The unit features conical dispersion suitable for vertical or horizontal mounting, with compatibility for pan-tilt U-brackets and VESA 100 x 100 rear mounting across walls, ceilings, and truss.

  • 15-inch coaxial driver with 2.5-inch voice coil, 98 dB sensitivity

  • 90 x 90 degrees coverage, 122 dB max SPL, 300 W

  • VESA 100 x 100, 8 x M10 fly points, M10 safety point

Title: IQ-8000
Sub Title: Four-channel 2000W Class-D installation amplifier with DSP
Product Description:
The MAG Audio IQ-8000 is a four-channel Class-D amplifier delivering 4 x 2000 W into 4 ohm in a compact 2U chassis. It supports 16 AES3 digital input channels alongside analog inputs and includes a built-in WebUI for matrix routing, room EQ, and automation. Designed for professional fixed installations requiring high power density and remote management.

  • 4 x 2000 W @ 4 ohm, 4 x 1000 W @ 8 ohm, 4 x 600 W @ 16 ohm

  • 16 AES3 digital input channels with full matrix routing

  • Integrated WebUI for EQ, delay, grouping, and monitoring

Title: PD-1x8
Sub Title: 2U single-amp power distributor with analog, AES3, network
Product Description:
The MAG Audio PD-1x8 is a 19 in 2U power distributor that branches mains power and signal for a single high-power amplifier slot. It consolidates CEE 32A input, analog and AES/EBU signal links, EtherCon network, and 8x Speakon 4-pin plus 2x Speakon 8-pin loudspeaker outputs in a single panel. Designed for MAG Audio AmpRack and WAR fly-rack integrations using Neutrik and PCE connectors.

  • CEE 32A 3P+N+E mains input with link-through

  • 8x Speakon 4-pin and 2x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs

  • 4x analog XLR plus 2x AES/EBU XLR with link-through

Title: PD-2T604
Sub Title: 2U dual-amplifier IEC C19 power distribution panel
Product Description:
The MAG Audio PD-2T604 is a 19 in 2U power distributor for two amplifiers, terminating mains power on 2x IEC C19 outlets instead of dedicated amplifier connectors. It carries 4x analog XLR and 2x AES/EBU XLR with link-through plus 2x EtherCon network, and provides 8x Speakon 4-pin and 2x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs. Built for touring AmpRacks and MN mounting racks using Neutrik and PCE connectors.

  • 2x IEC C19 amplifier mains outlets plus 1x AUX Schuko

  • CEE 32A 3P+N+E input with link-through

  • 8x Speakon 4-pin and 2x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs

Title: PD-2x4
Product Description:
The MAG Audio PD-2x4 is a 19 in 2U power distributor designed to feed two Powersoft X-Series amplifiers from a single CEE 32A mains feed. It carries 4x analog XLR and 2x AES/EBU XLR with link-through, 2x EtherCon for network, and 8x Speakon 4-pin plus 2x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs. Built for AmpRack, MN, and WAR rack integrations using Neutrik and PCE connectors.

  • 2x Powersoft X-Series mains outlets plus 1x AUX Schuko

  • CEE 32A 3P+N+E input with link-through

  • 8x Speakon 4-pin and 2x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs

Title: PD-2x8
Sub Title: 3U dual-amp high-density Powersoft X-Series power distributor
Product Description:
The MAG Audio PD-2x8 is a 19 in 3U power distributor for two Powersoft X-Series amplifiers with doubled signal and speaker capacity. It provides 4x analog XLR, 2x AES/EBU XLR with link-through, 2x EtherCon network, and 16x Speakon 4-pin plus 4x Speakon 8-pin loudspeaker outputs. Sized for touring AmpRack, MN, and WAR fly-rack systems using Neutrik and PCE connectors.

  • 2x Powersoft X-Series mains outlets plus 1x AUX Schuko

  • 16x Speakon 4-pin and 4x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs

  • CEE 32A 3P+N+E input

Title: PD-3x4
Product Description:
The MAG Audio PD-3x4 is a 19 in 3U power distributor that feeds three Powersoft X-Series amplifiers from a single CEE 32A mains feed. It supplies 4x analog XLR, 2x AES/EBU XLR with link-through, 2x EtherCon network, and 12x Speakon 4-pin plus 3x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs. Built for MAG Audio AmpRack, MN, and WAR fly-rack assemblies using Neutrik and PCE connectors.

  • 3x Powersoft X-Series mains outlets plus 2x AUX Schuko

  • 12x Speakon 4-pin and 3x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs

  • CEE 32A 3P+N+E input with link-through

Title: PD-4x4
Product Description:
The MAG Audio PD-4x4 is a 19 in 3U power distributor designed to feed four Powersoft X-Series amplifiers from a single CEE 32A mains feed. It provides 4x analog XLR, 2x AES/EBU XLR with link-through, 2x EtherCon network, and 16x Speakon 4-pin plus 4x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs. Built for MAG Audio AmpRack, MN, and WAR fly-rack assemblies using Neutrik and PCE connectors.

  • 4x Powersoft X-Series mains outlets plus 1x AUX Schuko

  • 16x Speakon 4-pin and 4x Speakon 8-pin speaker outputs

  • CEE 32A 3P+N+E mains input

Title: BEE-12
Product Description:
BEE-12 is a passive universal FOH and stage monitoring speaker fitted with a low-distortion 12 in coaxial driver with a 3 in low-frequency voice coil and a 2.8 in HF voice coil. It connects via industry-standard Speakon for simple integration into any sound reinforcement setup.

  • 12 in coaxial driver, 96 dB sensitivity, 135 dB max SPL

  • 80 x 80 degrees coverage, 500 W nominal power

  • M10 fly points, 35mm pole socket, M10 safety point

Title: BEE-15
Product Description:
BEE-15 is a passive FOH and stage monitoring speaker featuring a 15 in coaxial driver with a 3 in voice coil. Connects via industry-standard Speakon for simple integration into sound reinforcement setups, with flytrack and pole mount options.

  • 15 in coaxial driver, 97 dB sensitivity, 136 dB max SPL

  • 80 x 80 degrees coverage, 500 W nominal power

  • M10 fly points, 35mm pole socket, M10 safety point

Title: Cluster Q4 IP
Product Description:
Cluster Q4 IP is an installation line array module based on 4x 6 in LF drivers and 2x 1 in HF drivers with 1.75 in voice coils, offering a 4 degree splay angle. Reliable enclosure and carefully designed components make the system a perfect option for fixed installations of different sizes. IP54-rated for outdoor installations.

  • 4x 6 in woofers + 2x 1 in HF on 1.75 in voice coils

  • 138 dB max SPL, 4 degree splay, 80 degrees horizontal coverage

  • IP54 weatherized enclosure for outdoor use

Title: CUE Li
Product Description:
CUE Li is the largest in-wall model in the CUE Series, engineered for concealed high-output applications. With six woofers, four passive radiators, and the same high-resolution 1 in tweeter as the surface-mounted CUE L, it delivers authoritative full-range performance behind fabric or false walls. Intended for large spaces where visual minimalism is non-negotiable.

  • 6 x 2 in woofers + 4 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 114.5 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Concealed in-wall installation, 12 Ohm

Title: CUE Mi
Product Description:
CUE Mi is the in-wall counterpart to CUE M, providing increased output and coverage for hidden installations. Features a four-woofer setup, dual passive radiators, and the series-standard 1 in tweeter for consistent performance across mixed visible and concealed systems. Ideal for restaurants, galleries, and public interiors requiring clean architectural surfaces.

  • 4 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 111 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Concealed in-wall installation, 8 Ohm

Title: CUE Si
Product Description:
CUE Si is the in-wall version of CUE S, designed for fully concealed installations behind acoustically transparent surfaces. Utilizing the same dual 2 in woofers, passive radiators, and 1 in high-frequency driver as the surface-mounted model, CUE Si achieves identical tonal balance and clarity while maintaining a more discreet visual presence.

  • 2 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 105 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Concealed in-wall installation, 4 Ohm

Title: CUE Sub
Product Description:
CUE Sub is an ultra-slim, on-wall subwoofer designed to extend low-frequency performance in architectural installations without occupying floor space. Featuring dual 8 in drivers firing directly into the wall, it delivers controlled, punchy bass while remaining physically safe and visually discreet. Supplied with an integrated mounting bracket.

  • Dual 8 in drivers with 1.5 in voice coils

  • 122 dB max SPL, 45-200 Hz response, 400 W

  • Ultra-slim on-wall enclosure with integrated bracket

Title: CUE L
Product Description:
CUE L is the flagship column of the CUE Series. Six woofers combined with four passive radiators deliver enhanced low-frequency weight, paired with the shared 1 in tweeter. Engineered for demanding installations requiring higher SPL, extended coverage, and authoritative presence. Suitable for clubs, performance spaces, and large public interiors.

  • 6 x 2 in woofers + 4 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 114.5 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Aluminum enclosure, 12 Ohm, 150 W

Title: CUE M
Product Description:
CUE M is the balanced workhorse of the CUE Series, offering increased output and coverage while maintaining a slim architectural profile. With four woofers, dual passive radiators, and the same high-resolution 1 in tweeter used across the series, CUE M provides confident midrange projection and controlled low frequencies. Well-suited for bars, restaurants, galleries, and medium-scale spaces.

  • 4 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 111 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Aluminum enclosure, 8 Ohm, 100 W

Title: CUE S
Product Description:
CUE S is the most compact loudspeaker within the CUE Series lineup. Dual 2 in woofers, dual passive radiators, and a precision 1 in high-frequency driver deliver articulate sound with surprising low-end presence for its size. Suits intimate venues, corridors, lounges, and architectural accents.

  • 2 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 105 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Aluminum enclosure, 4 Ohm, 50 W

Title: FLY-R60
Sub Title: High-output passive line array module (R series)
Product Description:
FLY-R60 is a potent passive line array solution featuring four 6.5 in woofers and two 1.4 in high-frequency transducers. Engineered for short to medium-throw applications, delivering 70 degrees horizontal coverage with a 0 degree vertical splay angle for controlled dispersion. Integrated flying hardware enables flexible mounting.

  • 4 x 6.5 in LF drivers and 2 x 1.4 in HF drivers

  • 125 dB max SPL, 70 degrees H coverage, 0 degree V splay

  • 600 W power handling, 8 Ohm

Title: FLY-R68
Sub Title: High-output passive line array module, wider coverage
Product Description:
FLY-R68 is engineered for short and medium-throw applications, featuring four 6.5 in woofers and two 1.4 in high-frequency drivers. It delivers 110 degrees horizontal coverage with an 8 degree vertical splay angle, providing tightly controlled dispersion and high intelligibility.

  • 4 x 6.5 in LF drivers and 2 x 1.4 in HF drivers

  • 125 dB max SPL, 110 degrees H coverage, 8 degree V splay

  • 600 W power handling, 8 Ohm

Title: FLY-R8B
Product Description:
FLY-R8B is a passive cardioid subwoofer engineered for concert halls, theaters, and clubs. A unique six-driver configuration with four front-firing and two rear-firing 8 in woofers achieves up to -16 dB rear cancellation, reducing stage noise and focusing sound toward the audience.

  • Six 8 in drivers (4 front-firing + 2 rear-firing)

  • Cardioid pattern with up to -16 dB rear cancellation

  • 127 dB max SPL, 45-200 Hz response

Title: Focus 5
Product Description:
Focus 5 is a discreet yet powerful stage bi-amp monitor featuring a 15 in LF coaxial driver. Designed for performers prioritizing comfort and clarity, it offers bi-amp connectivity for precise sound control and includes pole mount compatibility for DJ, backline, and FOH applications.

  • 15 in coaxial driver, bi-amp connectivity

  • 137 dB peak SPL, 40 x 80 degrees coverage

  • 35mm pole adapter compatible

Title: Focus Sub
Product Description:
Focus Sub is a passive monitor subwoofer featuring a 15 in LF driver designed to enhance the Focus series. Together with Focus 5, it creates a powerful monitor set for a drummer, providing impeccable low-frequency support for DJ monitoring, backline, and FOH applications.

  • 15 in driver with 4 in voice coil

  • 139 dB peak SPL, 38-200 Hz response

  • 1000 W nominal power, 8 Ohm

Title: Sub 12
Product Description:
Sub 12 is a versatile low-frequency extension loudspeaker for reinforcing full-range cabinets. Compact passive subwoofer featuring a 12 in woofer with 3 in voice coil. Delivers significant sound pressure with an efficient vented box design, suitable for mobile sound systems and small-scale installations.

  • 12 in woofer with 3 in voice coil

  • 133.5 dB peak SPL, 45-300 Hz response

  • 450 W nominal power, 4/8 Ohm

Title: Sub 12A
Product Description:
Sub 12A is a compact yet powerful low-frequency extension powered loudspeaker. Features a proprietary 12 in woofer with 3 in voice coil and efficient vented box design. Equipped with a built-in 650 W Class D amplifier with DSP, designed for mobile sound systems and smaller installations.

  • 12 in driver with built-in 650 W Class D amplifier

  • 127.5 dB max SPL, 43-170 Hz response

  • XLR input/output and DSP onboard

Title: Sub 15A
Product Description:
Sub 15A is a low-profile 15 in powered subwoofer designed to reinforce full-range speakers. Combines light weight, significant sound pressure output, and compact dimensions with a built-in 1400 W Class D amplifier - ideal for mobile professionals seeking transportable sound reinforcement.

  • 15 in driver with built-in 1400 W Class D amplifier

  • 134 dB max SPL, 35-170 Hz response

  • XLR input/output and onboard DSP

Title: Sub 18
Product Description:
Sub 18 is advised for mobile speaker sets and fixed installations alike due to high performance, low weight, and compact dimensions. Features an 18 in neodymium woofer with extended low-frequency capability, delivering 140 dB peak SPL.

  • 18 in neodymium woofer with 4 in voice coil

  • 140 dB peak SPL, 33-300 Hz response

  • 1000 W nominal power, 4/8 Ohm

Title: HTF-01
Sub Title: Universal flying frame for HORNET 12 arrays
Product Description:
HTF-01 is a universal flying frame for HORNET arrays, enabling linear array installation. Lightweight and transportable, it supports up to 16 Hornet 12 units and is suited for wall, ceiling, indoor, and outdoor mounting. Accessory, not a loudspeaker.

  • Compatible with HORNET 12 arrays, up to 16 units

  • Lightweight 30 kg construction

  • Suitable for wall, ceiling, indoor and outdoor mounting

Title: WASP-8i
Sub Title: Dual 8-inch passive install line array module
Product Description:
WASP-8i is an installation line array module based on dual 8 in woofers with a 1.4 in throat HF driver. A compact line array speaker designed for venues ranging from small clubs to concert halls, delivering significant power with numerous mounting options.

  • 2 x 8 in LF drivers with 1.4 in throat HF

  • 138 dB max SPL, interchangeable 100 / 70 degrees H coverage

  • 600 W LF / 100 W HF, 16 Ohm both channels
